# Helvety Contacts

> Encrypted contacts with names, numbers, birthdays, and notes. Personal, Work, and Other groups. Engineered, designed and made in Switzerland.

## Product behavior
- Encrypted names, numbers, birthdays, and notes in Personal, Work, and Other groups
- New contact opens an empty editor sheet (save-first create); the record is stored on first save with a client-generated id
- Client-side search on decrypted fields and JSON export when you need a copy
- Shareable links use `?contact=<uuid>` to open a contact in the detail sheet after sign-in and vault unlock
- Optional cross-app links to Helvety Tasks, Notes, and Links when those apps are in use

## Canonical URL
- [Contacts App](https://helvety.com/contacts): Auth-required contacts route

## Crawling And Indexing
- Contacts routes are intended not to be indexed.
- These routes are not intended as crawl targets and are protected by noindex metadata and authentication controls.
